decision_notes: The Constitution establishes the territorial legislature and general lawmaking power (sections 62 and 71), together with public-finance and ministerial-government provisions. British Overseas Territory; separate VG map parent and UK search association. Primary evidence: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/1678/pdfs/uksi_20071678_en.pdf ; https://www.gov.vg/legislative-branch

Official House website links the channel and identifies its legislative role. A fifth-sitting/third-session/fifth-House continuation plays beyond its recess slate. Another sampled continuation remains in recess at the chosen timestamp. The government overview has a conflicting membership summary; use the constitutional text for powers and do not repeat those membership figures.

Source conditions: The reviewed official pages designate public viewing and retain copyright notices; no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Keep the official link rather than extracting, embedding or redistributing provider media.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
